questions.question: A alone can finish a job in 5 days and B alone can finish the same job in 2 days. If they both work together, in how many days will be job be finished?
questions.solution:
As we know,

Efficiency inversely proportional to time

Efficiency of A to B = 2 : 5

Total work = 2 × 5 = 10

∴ Required time = 10/(2 + 5) = 10/7 = 1(3)/(7)

questions.question: X bought three items from a store for an average price of Rs. 15 each. If the sum of prices of the first two items was twice the average price of all the items, then what was the price of the third item?
questions.solution:
Average price of three items = Rs. 15

Sum of three items = Rs. 15 × 3 = Rs. 45

According to the question

Sum of prices of the first two items = 2 × 15 = 30

∴ Price of third items = 45 – 30 = Rs. 15

questions.question: The sum of the present ages of A and B is 60. Three years ago, the ratio of the ages of A and B was 5 : 4. Find the present age of A.
questions.solution:
Sum of the present ages of A and B = 60 years

Sum of the ages of A and B three years ago = 60 – 6 = 54

Three years ago, ratio of the ages of A and B = 5x : 4x

According to the question

⇒ 5x + 4x = 54

⇒ 9x = 54

⇒ x = 6

Now, three years ago, age of A = 5x = 5 × 6 = 30

∴ Present age of A = 30 + 3 = 33 years

questions.question: The cost of a product was Rs. 175 and it was sold at a loss of 10% what is the selling price?
questions.solution:
Cost price of the product = Rs. 175

Product was sold at a loss 10%

∴ Selling price of the product = Rs. 175 × 90/100 = Rs. 157.5

questions.question: A 2-m-long scooter moves past a plank completely in 5 s. The length of the plank is 3 m. What is the speed of the scooter?
questions.solution:
Total distance to be covered = 2 + 3 = 5 m

We know, Speed = Distance/Time

∴ Speed of the scooter = 5/5 = 1 m/s

Two trains, 200 m and 140 m long, are running on parallel tracks in the opposite directions at a speed of 60 km/h and 30 km/h, respectively. What will be the time taken by the trains to cross each other completely?
questions.solution:
Total length of both trains = 200 + 140 = 340 m

Relative speed of both trains = 60 + 30 = 90 km/h = 90 × [5/18] = 25 m/s

As we know, Time = Distance/Speed

∴ Required time= 340/25 = 13(15)/(25) second

Find the value of [20 + (2 × 10) ÷ (2 + 3) – 2] + 2
questions.solution:
Follow BODMAS rule to solve this question, as per the order given below:

Step-1: Parts of an equation enclosed in 'Brackets' must be solved first, and in the bracket,

Step-2: Any mathematical 'Of' or 'Exponent' must be solved next,

Step-3: Next, the parts of the equation that contain 'Division' and 'Multiplication' are calculated,

Step-4: Last but not least, the parts of the equation that contain 'Addition' and 'Subtraction' should be calculated.

[20 + (2 × 10) ÷ (2 + 3) – 2] + 2

⇒ [20 + 20 ÷ 5 – 2] + 2

⇒ [20 + 4 – 2] + 2

⇒ 22 + 2

⇒ 24

questions.question: A pipe fills 2/6 of a cistern in 15 min. How long will it take to completely fill the cistern?
questions.solution:
Pipe fill 2/6 of a cistern in = 15 min

∴ Pipe fill whole cistern in = 15 × [6/2] = 45 min

questions.question: A sum of money was distributed among A, B, C and D in a proportion of 5 : 4 : 3 : 2, respectively. If B receive Rs. 2,000 more than what D received, then what was C’s share?
questions.solution:
Let the ratio of A, B, C and D = 5x : 4x : 3x : 2x

According to the question

⇒ 4x – 2x = Rs. 2000

⇒ 2x = Rs. 2000

⇒ C’s share 3x = 2000 × [3/2] = Rs. 3000

questions.question: A workman wants to paint the top and bottom portions of a cylindrical object. What is the total surface area he would have to paint if it has a radius of 7 cm and a height of 10 cm?
questions.solution:
Given that the radius of the cylinder r = 7 cm

∴ Required area of the cylinder = πr² + πr² = 2πr² = 2 × 7 × 7 × π = 98π cm²

questions.question: The ratio of the number of Indian tourists that went to USA to the number of Indian tourists who were below 30 years of age respectively is∶
questions.solution:
Let the total number of tourists be x.

Number of tourists who went to USA = x × [40/100]

Number of tourists below 30 years = x × [15/100]

∴ Required ratio = x × [40/100] : x × [15/100] = 8 : 3

questions.question: An angle is 2° more than its complement. What is the measure of the angle?
questions.solution:
As we know,

Sum of two complement angle = 90°

Let one angle be x. So, the other angle will be (x – 2).

According to the question

⇒ x + x – 2 = 90°

⇒ x = 46°

questions.question: The cost price of a product was Rs. 395, and it was sold at a loss of 20%. What was the selling price of the product?
questions.solution:

The article was sold a loss 20%,

∴ SP of the product = Rs. 395 × [80/100] = Rs. 316

Amongst this 20%, 25% of the Indian tourist went to Switzerland.

questions.question: A sum of the money was distributed among A, B, C and D in a proportional of 5 : 2 : 3 : 2 respectively. If C received Rs. 500 more than what D received, then what was B’s share?
questions.solution:
Ratio of A, B, C and D = 5x : 2x : 3x : 2x

According to the question

⇒ 3x – 2x = 500

⇒ x = 500

⇒ 2x = 500 × 2 = 1000

questions.question:
What would be the wrong letter in the following series?

D, G, J, M, P, T, V, Y, B
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acf4b6d5015cdaa8efa096919fe1c4436954d8458e4e036518408518d26767f5.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

D + 3 → G; G + 3 → J; J + 3 → M; M + 3 → P; P + 3 → **S**; S + 3 → V;V + 3 → Y

Hence, ‘T’ is the wrong letter in the given series.
